Packaging requires the exact independent approval file/hash, explicit boolean approval, native source hash, actual canonical patch set, complete source evidence hashes and current generator hash.

acceptanceScope: Renderer inputs are transitively bound to the reviewed patch and lifecycle evidence; original and replacement spans must decode exactly and preserve source file offsets.
Current package code fails closed on incomplete geometry, stale approval/evidence/build, changed generator and moved patch locations before creating output.
Required Single0/contact guards, isolated provider checks and fresh output-directory protections remain active.

limitations: This review approves integration logic for a restricted runtime test; it does not mark the regenerated full manifest or the game test passed.
Root must regenerate/finalize static approval and isolated profile hashes after source/evidence changes; normal packaging checks must pass before deployment.
Existing renderer asynchronous scheduling remains unchanged; this review does not independently prove backend synchronization or arbitrary third-party provider behavior.
